name: Adam Kinzinger
summary:
Adam Daniel Kinzinger (; born February 27, 1978) is an American politician, political commentator, and former United States Air Force and Air National Guard officer. A member of the Republican Party, he served as a U.S. representative from Illinois from 2011 to 2023, representing Illinois's 11th congressional district and later its 16th district.
Kinzinger was first elected to Congress in 2010 from the 11th district.
